projectMove.title: Cruise: lock dinner time and bed setup this week
projectMove.body: Check-in is already done, with boarding group C02 and an 11:00 to 11:30 AM arrival on November 1, so the only open items left are your dining time and your cabin bed choice. Both live in the Carnival app, take a couple of minutes, and the better dinner slots tend to fill as sailing day gets closer, so locking them in this week keeps your options open.

tip.title: Catch the Hunter's Moon before it sets this morning
tip.body: October's full moon peaked at 12:12 AM and is still nearly full. It sits low in the west under a clear sky and sets at 8:17 AM, so a quick look out a west-facing window before work is the easy win. Tonight's rise is around 7:06 PM, but clouds look likely this evening.

surprise.title: The Hunter's Moon peaked just after midnight
surprise.body: October's full moon, traditionally called the Hunter's Moon, was exactly full at 12:12 AM this morning and is still 99% lit. Right now it is sinking in the west over a clear sky and sets at 8:17 AM, so a quick look out a west-facing window before work catches it. Tonight it rises at 7:06 PM, but clouds look likely through the evening, and tomorrow night clears up again. By the time the ship sails on November 1 it will be a half-lit last quarter moon, rising late that night over open water.
